svg.title: Code runs in the sandbox. Your keys stay on the host.
svg.desc: Your process holds the agent loop, your tools, hooks and permissions, your model and sandbox API keys, and a git gateway for git_push and pull requests. It sends tool calls to the sandbox (E2B, Daytona or Modal), which runs bash, read, write, edit, ls, glob, grep and notebook_edit, and returns results. The sandbox has no credentials and no internet by default.
svg.text: Code runs in the sandbox. Your keys stay on the host.
The agent reaches the sandbox only through tools. Credentials never enter it.
